notes.title: dysto-wanderer demo is available now /ᐠ > ˕
notes.content:
hey everyone! the wait is over, [b]dysto-wanderer demo is finally live[/b] on steam and ready for you to play.

this is just the beginning: dive into the first 2 levels, solve some wild puzzles, and run through the ruins of a world that's seen better days.

it will be [b]available for a month[/b], so grab your fav drink and test it out. and [b]don't forget to wishlist[/b] if you haven't yet! your support means the world to me ♥︎
